rows.project_specific_advantage_or_remaining_: Scoped implemented capability: deterministic offline DOCX redaction is stdlib-only, rejects active content using package relationships/content types instead of filename substring matching alone, validates decoded XML text, XML well-formedness, and minimal OOXML package structure before publication, scans ZIP member names/comments/archive comments plus payloads for policy literals, and persists only aggregate receipt evidence.
